extensionDescription.message: Highlights already open tabs when you hover a link, and briefly highlights duplicates when you open a tab.

showCounterDesc.message: Shows a number on the extension icon while you hover a link, and briefly after you switch to a tab.

enableDuplicateHighlightLabel.message: Flash duplicate tabs when you switch to a tab

enableDuplicateHighlightDesc.message: Other open copies are briefly selected in the tab bar (multi-select style).

enableHoverHighlightLabel.message: Select duplicate tabs when you hover a link

enableHoverHighlightDesc.message: Matching tabs in the tab bar are highlighted while the cursor is on the link. Works alongside the on-page highlight below.

hoverDelayDesc.message: Wait time before any hover reaction starts.

autoHideDelayDesc.message: How long duplicate tabs stay selected after you switch to a tab.

unhighlightOnWindowLeaveLabel.message: Clear highlights when the cursor leaves the page

unhighlightOnWindowLeaveDesc.message: Turn off if highlights should stay while you move the cursor to the tab bar or side panel.

linkHighlightEnabledLabel.message: Highlight the hovered link on the page

linkHighlightEnabledDesc.message: Draws a frame, underline, or glow on the page itself (in addition to tab-bar selection).

linkHighlightScopeHiddenDesc.message: Useful when hidden tabs cannot be selected in the tab bar.

linkHighlightScopeAlwaysDesc.message: Shows on-page highlight together with tab-bar selection.

linkHighlightCardDesc.message: Thin frame around the result block.

linkHighlightUnderlineDesc.message: Line under each line of link text — good for plain text links.

linkHighlightGlowDesc.message: Gentle outer glow around the link area or card.

highlightAccentDesc.message: Default color for all styles. Pick a preset or tap the palette icon for a custom color.

siteAccessPromptBody.message: To highlight links when you hover them, the extension needs access to web pages.

siteAccessSkipHint.message: You can continue without this — tab-bar features stay available, but on-page link highlighting will not work.

siteAccessInlineBody.message: On-page link highlighting is off — site access was not granted. Grant access to enable it.

siteAccessDenied.message: Permission was not granted. Enable it in Add-ons → Permissions.

siteAccessFallback.message: Click “Grant access” above and allow in the dialog, or open about:addons → Highlight Opened Tabs → Permissions and enable “Access your data for all websites”.

permissionMissingTooltip.message: Site access is off — hover highlighting is disabled. Click to fix.

grantBody.message: To highlight already open tabs when you hover a link, Firefox needs access to websites. This is required for the main feature — click the button below once.

grantDone.message: Done. Reload open pages, then hover a link.

grantDenied.message: Permission was not granted. Link hover will not work until you allow it.
